source.how: need = unique RTL source bits per (src part, dst part, kind) from tools/hbm_b2/b2_delays.py over the B2 die top (b2_top.py over b2_bind_wiring.json); reproduced locally (capacity_over 26 / no_lane 7 identical) and broken down per source port

rule: need = RTL bits; the plan's per-lane epoch bit (schema.has_epoch) is extra and NOT counted.  A mirrored bundle (NW pair / NE pair, one bus per replicated type) is sized to max(need NW, need NE).  A bundle may be carried by several lanes on different paths (b2_delays sums their widths; the binder pads to the slowest).  Widths only grow.  b2n.py checks every bundle's capacity after the delta.
